### VREG\_2V7 external DC loading and NVM-jig voltage matching

<EvidenceAnchor id="cov-stusb-vreg2v7-load" />

**Coverage ID:** `cov-stusb-vreg2v7-load` · **Status:** OPEN

**Reason:** Pin 23 (VREG\_2V7) is documented decoupling-only in DS12499, yet Board P loads it with R15/R16 4.7k I2C pull-ups and exposes it on debug pogo pad J3.3 (net U1.23 C30.2 R15.2 R16.2 J3.3); closure requires a manufacturer-primary locator authorizing this external DC load (or a re-route decision, out of this plan's scope) plus confirmation that the NVM-programming jig's logic levels match 2.7 V before issue #34's programming artifact executes

## Interactions

Behaviour that is not a property of this part alone. Each interaction names the records it spans, the conditions it holds under, and how far it has been confirmed. An interaction that spans several parts appears on every one of their pages, under the same identifier, because it is equally a fact about each.

### int-stusb-netlist

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-stusb-netlist" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-stusb4500qtr` (this record)
- **Conditions:** Assert U1.24=VBUS\_IN; U1.18 reaches VBUS\_IN only through R14; U1.9 reaches VBUS\_OUT only through R13; U1.16=VBEN drives the PMOS gate network; U1.1/5 bridge through R19/R20 to CC1/CC2; U1.22 and EP are GND; NC pins remain NC; U1.23=VREG\_2V7 also bridges to R15.2/R16.2 (I2C pull-ups) and pogo pad J3.3, an external DC load beyond decoupling that DS12499 does not yet authorize
- **Verdict:** UNSOURCED

**Facts this rests on:**

- [`fact-stusb-pin-states`](#fact-stusb-pin-states)

- [`fact-stusb-vben`](#fact-stusb-vben)

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-stusb-safe-power" />

- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH

### int-stusb-nvm-verification

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-stusb-nvm-verification" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-stusb4500qtr` (this record)
- **Conditions:** Capture factory 40 bytes; diff intended normalized 40-byte image; write once within verified endurance; read all 40 bytes; reset and read; remove all power long enough for rails to collapse and read again; decode PDO/polarity/discharge fields and negotiate each intended profile
- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH

**Facts this rests on:**

- [`fact-stusb-nvm-load`](#fact-stusb-nvm-load)

## Legend

What the recorded terms on this page mean, in ordinary words. The exact terms above are the ones that count; these descriptions explain them and never replace them.

### Verdict

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                                       |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NEEDS BENCH` | Cannot be settled from documents. It needs measurement on real hardware before it can be relied on. |
| `UNSOURCED`   | No accepted source backs this value yet. Treat it as a claim, not a fact.                           |

### Provenance

| Recorded term      | What it means                                                                                  |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `PROJECT-CHOICE`   | A decision made by this project. No vendor asserts it.                                         |
| `REFERENCE-DESIGN` | Taken from a vendor reference design or application note rather than the device specification. |
| `UNVERIFIED`       | Recorded, but not yet backed by an accepted source.                                            |

### Fact class

| Recorded term           | What it means                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ABSOLUTE_MAXIMUM`      | A never-exceed limit. Reaching it may damage the part; it is not an operating target and there is no margin implied by it.                                         |
| `GUARANTEED_ELECTRICAL` | A parameter the manufacturer guarantees over the stated conditions, usually with minimum, typical and maximum values.                                              |
| `PROJECT_STATE`         | A value this project recorded about how the part is used here — a chosen operating point, a net assignment, or a derived figure. Not a manufacturer specification. |
| `RECOMMENDED_OPERATION` | The range the manufacturer intends the part to be used in. Always narrower than the absolute maximum.                                                              |
| `TRANSIENT`             | Behaviour during a short event — startup, a switching edge, a fault or a surge.                                                                                    |

### Coverage status

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                                                               |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `OPEN`        | Unresolved. Open means the question has not been answered, not that the part is unsafe — the reason states what is missing. |

### Source availability

| Recorded term        | What it means                                                                                                         |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `AVAILABLE`          | The document was retrieved and is on record.                                                                          |
| `SOURCE UNAVAILABLE` | The document could not be retrieved. It stays listed so the gap is visible; anything resting on it remains unsourced. |

### Source authority

| Recorded term          | What it means                                                                                            |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `MANUFACTURER_MIRROR`  | A copy of a manufacturer document hosted elsewhere. Usable, but weaker than the manufacturer's own copy. |
| `MANUFACTURER_PRIMARY` | The manufacturer's own document for this exact part.                                                     |
| `PROJECT_GENERATOR`    | A document this project generated, such as a schematic or netlist export.                                |
| `REFERENCE_DESIGN`     | A reference design or application note rather than a device specification.                               |

### Identity state

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                                                                    |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `UNRESOLVED`  | The exact orderable part is not yet confirmed. Substituting a same-name part from another vendor is not permitted on that basis. |

### Source state

| Recorded term        | What it means                                     |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `SOURCE UNAVAILABLE` | No document backing this line could be retrieved. |

### Unit

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                      |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NONE`        | The value is not a physical quantity, so it carries no unit. Recorded as \`NONE\`. |
